title: Create Decision Impact Analysis service
acceptance_criteria: Pure function: link_decisions_to_commits(decisions, commits) -> list[dict] with decision_id, commit_sha, match_score
Pure function: track_reversals(decision_tree) -> list[dict] with original_id, reversal_id, reversal_type
Pure function: compute_impact_analysis(memory_manager, project_name) -> dict with linked_commits, reversals, impact_score
All functions < 50 lines, no side effects
